products.name: Nandina Flower Brooch
products.description: A delicate Nandina flower takes shape in this handcrafted brooch, with layered petals and contrasting metallic detailing that brings the bloom to life. Made from 925 sterling silver, the textured finish gives it a refined botanical character, making it a beautiful accent for clothing, scarves or gifting.

products.name: Silver Calla Lily Flower Brooch
products.description: A sculpted Calla Lily forms the focal point of this elegant brooch, with its slender stem and graceful curved flower creating a refined silhouette. Crafted in 925 sterling silver with an 18K gold-plated finish, the minimalist design adds a sophisticated botanical touch to any outfit.

products.name: Classic Chain
products.description: A sleek, finely crafted chain designed to complement your favourite pendants and charms. Made from 925 sterling silver, its clean, understated finish makes it an effortless everyday essential.

products.name: Minimalist Choker Chain
products.description: A sleek, minimalist choker designed with a fine circular silhouette and a delicate centre drop detail. Crafted from 925 sterling silver, its clean design makes it easy to layer with other necklaces or wear on its own. Available in Gold and Silver finishes.
